Built so only you can read your mail.

Your inbox is the key to your accounts, your clients and your calendar. Here is how Typhoonpost keeps it protected.

Isolation enforced by the database

Each message, contact and calendar event belongs to one account. Access rules run inside the database itself, so even a bug in the app cannot hand one customer another customer's mail.

Messages are cleaned before they are shown

HTML in incoming mail is sanitised in your browser before display. Scripts, embedded forms and unsafe links are removed so a hostile message cannot act on your behalf.

Mail that proves where it came from

Outgoing mail is signed with DKIM and sent from servers authorised by SPF on your domain. Receivers can verify it really came from you, which protects your reputation and your recipients.

Encrypted in transit

Connections between your browser, the application and the database use TLS, so messages cannot be read or altered on the way.

What we promise.

  • Your mail is yours alone

    Every message is locked to your account at the database level. Other users and other tenants can never read it, even by accident.

  • Hostile HTML gets stripped

    Incoming messages are sanitised before they are displayed, so scripts, tracking tricks and unsafe links do not get a chance to run.

  • Authenticated sending

    Mail goes out through verified SPF and DKIM on your own domain, which keeps your messages out of junk folders.

  • We sell mailboxes, not attention

    There is no ad profile built from your messages. Typhoonpost is paid for by the people who use it.

  • Custom domains for your team

    Bring your own domain and give everyone a professional address that you control.

  • Open about how it works

    Plain-language policies and a public roadmap, so you always know what is happening with your data.
